description: 200 self-calibration questions, curated using runs run-00 through run-03. Answers are booleans: true means yes; false means no. Each of 10 topics has four questions per difficulty, two true and two false. Difficulty labels are provisional, not measured confidence bins. Provide only id and question to the model; retain all other fields for scoring. Mathematical values are exact unless stated otherwise. New questions require evaluation to establish confidence-bucket coverage.
